units.source_text: [\[3\]](#part1331.html#w3) 警卫皇宫门内的近卫府武官，

en.t: The military officers of the Inner Palace Guards who guarded the gates within the imperial palace,

units.source_text: 其左右长官称大将，次官称中将、少将，

en.t: their left and right commanders were called generals, and the deputy officers were called middle generals and minor generals,

units.source_text: 三等官称将监，四等官称将曹。

en.t: third-rank officers were called shogen, and fourth-rank officers were called shoso.
